label: Guided demo — pre-verified opportunities
scope: Prepared for AI Raw Gourmet's stated recipe and meal-plan generation/adaptation goal. Official product identity and advertised capabilities were checked on 27 October 2026. Business benefits are hypotheses, not tested outcomes. No live AI discovery or product trial is running.

candidates.title: DishGen
candidates.description: DishGen can generate all-new recipes and meal plans on demand.
candidates.business_summary: A ready-to-use AI recipe and meal-planning product that accepts ingredient and dietary requests, according to its official page.
candidates.business_benefit: Could help you compare a ready-made recipe-drafting approach with AI Raw Gourmet's planned way of adapting recipes to customer constraints before building more features.
candidates.next_step: Compare one public DishGen recipe example with a fictional customer's preferences and note which details need human correction.
limitations: Official-page verification only: no recipe generation, accuracy test or integration trial was performed.
Suitability for raw-food constraints, allergies and nutrition is unverified. Human review is necessary.

Check usage limits, data terms and commercial reuse rights before using outputs in your business; the site advertises commercial rights under its Pro offering. No subscription or generation is started here.

candidates.title: Samsung Food+
candidates.business_summary: A consumer meal-planning subscription with AI recipe personalization and tailored weekly plans, advertised on its official page.
candidates.business_benefit: Could give you a concrete benchmark for preference-based weekly planning, helping you decide which personalization steps matter for AI Raw Gourmet before investing in them.
candidates.next_step: Review the official weekly-planning description and write a checklist of preferences your own meal-planning journey must preserve.
limitations: Official-page verification only: no meal plan, account, trial or subscription was tested.
The advertised personalization and tailored plans are mobile-app features in a subscription product. Country availability and current terms need checking.
This is a consumer product to evaluate or benchmark, not a verified integration for AI Raw Gourmet. Raw-food suitability, dietary safety and commercial reuse remain unverified.
